title: ledger row whose vault_path does not exist -> NOT-VERIFIED(vault-absent)
spec_case: V4: a ledger row points at a vault path that does not exist. Expected: NOT-VERIFIED(vault-absent).
path_convention: substitute @FIXTURE_ROOT@ with the ROOT printed by make-fixture.sh; make-fixture.sh also writes the substituted copy to <ROOT>/expected.json
ledger_header: source_path	source_sha256	vault_path	vault_sha256	exported_at	note
live_ledger_untouched: corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv stays header-only; the builder never writes it (test ledgers live under tests/vault/)

declared_ledger_rows.why: the source file matches both row hashes (source_sha256 and vault_sha256 are the true digest of the exported bytes); the vault path is absent at evaluation time, so the vault side cannot be hashed

accept.note: a harness may render the verdict as one token or as separate verdict/reason fields; both satisfy this case as long as the verdict class is NOT-VERIFIED (never SAFE/VERIFIED) and the first/primary reason is vault-absent

must_not_be_note: the bare token VERIFIED is deliberately absent: harnesses (runner-26/28) apply must_not_be as a substring veto, and 'VERIFIED' is a substring of the correct answer 'NOT-VERIFIED(vault-absent)'. A false VERIFIED answer is still caught by the verdict-class comparison (want NOT-VERIFIED), which no correct answer can satisfy.
failure_modes_caught: source-side-only verification: source_sha256 matches the source file, so a harness that skips the vault-side presence/hash check reports VERIFIED/SAFE -- caught by expect.verdict
class collapse: reporting NOT-SAFE(none) or NOT-SAFE(unreachable) instead of the distinct NOT-VERIFIED(vault-absent) -- caught by expect.reason
false vault-absent on a vault-present pair: materializing the vault file (byte-identical to the source) must flip the round-2 tool to SAFE(moved-to-obsidian) -- exercised by selftest.sh

vault_side.why: parent exists, file absent: absence is exactly the file, not a missing tree

build.git: git init -q -b master on <ROOT> (offline, no commits) so the fixture root behaves like a real repo
build.determinism: fixed content bytes; paths vary per run; the content digest is asserted at build time
build.safety: never reads or writes the live ledger, the real vault, or any sibling repo; writes only under --out (plus --ledger FILE when given)

compat_note: targets[] + expect[] mirror the F1-F6 loader shape (path/verdict/receipt); expect[].receipt is null because vault verification is not a removal receipt; verdict/reason/verdict_string carry the V4 expectation

harness_hints.existing_tool: SOUJI_LEDGER=<ROOT>/ledger.tsv tools/souji-verify.sh <ROOT>/source/round-trip-notes.md  ->  NOT-SAFE(none) with evidence note obsidian=vault-unreachable (round-2 tool; round 4 must refine this to NOT-VERIFIED(vault-absent))
harness_hints.r4_tool: point the vault-verification harness at <ROOT>/ledger.tsv (env/flag per its CLI) and expect NOT-VERIFIED(vault-absent) for the single row
